EQUATION OF CONTINUITY.

Equation of Continuity in a Homogeneous Medium.
301.] If we express the components of the electromotive force
as the derivatives of the potential $V$, the equation of continuity
$$\frac{d u}{d x}+\frac{d v}{d y}+\frac{d w}{d z}=0$$
(15)
becomes in a homogeneous medium
$r_{1} \frac{d^{2} V}{d x^{2}}+r_{2} \frac{d^{2} V}{d y^{2}}+r_{3} \frac{d^{2} V}{d z^{2}}+28_{1} \frac{d^{2} V}{d y d z}+2 s_{2} \frac{d^{2} V}{d z d x}+28_{3} \frac{d^{2} V}{d x d y}=0$.
(16)
If the medium is not homogeneous there will be terms arising
from the variation of the coefficients of conductivity in passing
from one point to another.
This equation corresponds to Laplace's equation in a non-
isotropic medium.
302.] If we put
$$[r 8]=r_{1} r_{2} r_{3}+2 s_{1} s_{2} s_{3}-r_{1} s_{1}^{2}-r_{2} s_{2}^{2}-r_{3} s_{3}^{2}$$
(17)
and
$$[A B]=A_{1} A_{2} A_{3}+2 B_{1} B_{2} B_{3}-A_{1} B_{1}^{2}-A_{2} B_{2}^{2}-A_{3} B_{3}^{2}$$
(18)
where
$$\left.\begin{array}{c}
{[r s] A_{1}=r_{2} r_{3}-8_{1}^{2},} \\
{[r s] B_{1}=8_{2} 8_{3}-r_{1} 8_{1},}
\end{array}\right\}$$
(19)
and so on, the system $A, B$ will be inverse to the system $r, 8$, and
if we make
$$A_{1} x^{2}+A_{2} y^{2}+A_{3} z^{2}+2 B_{1} y z+2 B_{2} z x+2 B_{3} x y=[A B] \rho^{2}$$
(20)
we shall find that
$$V=\frac{C}{4 \pi} \frac{1}{\rho}$$
(21)
is a solution of the equation *.
* \{Suppose that by the transformation
$$\begin{aligned}
& x=a X+b Y+c Z, \\
& y=a^{\prime} X+b^{\prime} Y+c^{\prime} Z, \\
& z=a^{\prime \prime} X+b^{\prime \prime} Y+c^{\prime \prime} Z,
\end{aligned}$$
(1)
the left-hand side of (16) becomes
$$\frac{d^{2} V}{d X^{2}}+\frac{d^{2} V}{d Y^{2}}+\frac{d^{2} V}{d Z^{2}} .$$
(2)
For this to be the case, we see that
$$r_{1} \xi^{2}+r_{2} \eta^{2}+r_{3} \zeta^{2}+2 s_{1} \eta \zeta+\ldots$$
must be identical with
$$\left(a \xi+a^{\prime} \eta+a^{\prime \prime} \delta\right)^{2}+\left(b \xi+b^{\prime} \eta+b^{\prime \prime} \delta\right)^{2}+\left(c \xi+c^{\prime} \eta+c^{\prime \prime} \delta\right)^{2},$$
which we shall call $U$.
